name: Teen Volunteers at Pikes Peak Library District
what_you_do: Teens can see current volunteer chances through a link on the library teen volunteer page. The page does not list specific duties.
who_can_apply: Applications are open to people 13 and older. If you are 13 to 17 you need a parent or guardian permission.
duration: Summer Adventure season (2026). Other teen roles vary.
deadline_text: The page does not list volunteer dates. It links to current teen volunteer opportunities and gives a contact for questions.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the library volunteer system. If you do not want to apply online, email Karen Goates at kgoates@ppld.org.
notes: The age range 13 to 17 comes from the rule that people 13 and older apply and teens under 18 need permission. Call (719) 531-6333, ext. 6146 with questions.
